name: Reflow Vitrine
description: Restore the target shop-window arrangement through the visible task controls. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage; all implementation and hidden-state access is forbidden.
natural_language: Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, or page-state inspection; terminal, shell, or Python; address-bar or URL/query edits; reload or navigation; extensions; external applications; or any pre-existing, unrelated, blank, settings, or non-task tab. Restore the target window within eleven edits, then certify it.

metadata.source_notes: Grounded in VAB-CSS screenshot-guided iterative repair and SSIM evaluation, macOSWorld's live-preview layout reconstruction, and AgentStudio's gold-artifact slide-layout verification. The constraint tree, illustrated shop display, controls, generator, solver, and replay grader are original.
metadata.notes: The browser receives the generated public frame tree, initial rules, and target render geometry but not the target rules. The server and exported verifier independently replay the visible edit transcript and rasterize the final layout for grayscale structural similarity.
